from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation
from scipy.optimize import least_squares

def tf(xyz=(0,0,0), rpy=(0,0,0)):
    T=np.eye(4); T[:3,:3]=Rotation.from_euler('xyz',rpy).as_matrix(); T[:3,3]=xyz
    return T
ORIGINS=[tf((0,0,.333)),tf(rpy=(-np.pi/2,0,0)),tf((0,-.316,0),(np.pi/2,0,0)),tf((.0825,0,0),(np.pi/2,0,0)),tf((-.0825,.384,0),(-np.pi/2,0,0)),tf(rpy=(np.pi/2,0,0)),tf((.088,0,0),(np.pi/2,0,0))]

def fk(q):
    T=tf((0,-.4,.78),(0,0,np.pi/2))
    for origin,angle in zip(ORIGINS,q): T=T@origin@tf(rpy=(0,0,angle))
    return T@tf((0,0,.107),(0,0,-np.pi/4))

def ik(pos,rot,q):
    lim=np.array(r.spec()['action_types']['joint_position']['panda_joint_limits_rad'])
    def err(a):
        T=fk(a)
        return np.r_[10*(T[:3,3]-pos),Rotation.from_matrix(rot@T[:3,:3].T).as_rotvec(),.005*(a-q)]
    fit=least_squares(err,q,bounds=(lim[:,0]+.001,lim[:,1]-.001),xtol=1e-12,ftol=1e-12,gtol=1e-12,max_nfev=500)
    if np.linalg.norm(fk(fit.x)[:3,3]-pos)>.003: raise ValueError(f'IK failed {fit.fun}')
    return fit.x

def move(pos,rot=None,finger=.04,seconds=3,name='move'):
    obs=r.get_obs(cameras=[],video='none')
    now=np.array(obs.meta['proprio']['now'])
    if rot is None: rot=Rotation.from_euler('xyz',[np.pi,0,0]).as_matrix()
    q=ik(np.array(pos),rot,now[:7])
    start=np.r_[now[:7],now[14:16]]; end=np.r_[q,finger,finger]
    n=round(seconds/.1)
    a=start+(end-start)*np.linspace(0,1,n)[:,None]
    with (OUT/'commands.jsonl').open('a') as f: f.write(json.dumps({'name':name,'actions':a.tolist()})+'\n')
    res=r.submit('joint_position',a,dt=.1,cameras=None,video='none',include_depth=True,note=name)
    res.save(OUT/name)
    print(name,json.dumps(res.meta))
    return res

def unproject(cam,u,v,folder='initial'):
    s=r.spec()['cameras'][cam]; K=np.array(s['intrinsic_cv']); T=np.array(s['cam2world_gl'])
    d=np.load(OUT/folder/f'depth_{cam}.npy')[-1,v,u]
    p=np.array([(u-K[0,2])*d/K[0,0],-(v-K[1,2])*d/K[1,1],-d,1])
    return (T@p)[:3]

s='''"""Camera-guided Panda controller for select_mahjong_semantic i00.

Only the standard Robot interface is used. Positions were selected from RGB
and camera depth, and joint targets computed with numerical Panda IK.
commands.jsonl records every submitted motion, including recovery motions.
Running this file replays that command record, stopping on service termination.
No resets are requested. The original episode ended with reason=success.
"""\n'''+s
s+='''\n\ndef replay():
    status = r.status()
    if status['done']:
        print(json.dumps(status, indent=2))
        return
    for line in (OUT/'commands.jsonl').read_text().splitlines():
        motion = json.loads(line)
        result = r.submit('joint_position', motion['actions'], dt=.1,
                          interpolate='linear', cameras=['forward'],
                          video='none', note=motion['name'])
        print(motion['name'], result.meta.get('reason'))
        if result.done:
            break
    print(json.dumps(r.status(), indent=2))

if __name__ == '__main__':
    replay()
'''
p.write_text(s)
